comingLast.roast: at 1.1 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
tied with Lewington - two men, two blue balls, maths pending
level with Lewington at the wrong end - the tension is real and hilarious
cushion of 2 over Lewington - the bar has him at even money
above the blue balls by 2 - margin thinner than the clubhouse gravy
2 clear - his supporters (his group) keep reminding him loudly
the cushion is 2 - more of a coaster really
2 above the blue line - the bar keeps updating his odds
3 clear with 4 left - the survival pars start now
3 points of insurance at 1.4 a hole - premium unpaid
